stories.title: Alcaraz dethroned: How Shelton pulled off the upset
stories.summary: What went wrong for Carlos Alcaraz, what went right for Ben Shelton -- and who will win the US Open title now.

stories.title: Shelton stuns Alcaraz in latest US Open finish, sets up all-American semi
stories.summary: Ben Shelton ended Carlos Alcaraz's title reign in the latest-finishing match in US Open history, pulling out a 6-7 (5), 6-1, 6-3, 1-6, 7-6 (10-7) victory in a marathon tussle that ended at 3:33 a.m. ET.

stories.title: Sources: LSU closes roster at 105 without adding ex-NFL players
stories.summary: LSU has added two current student-athletes to its roster, closing it at 105 and eliminating the ability to add Dae'Quan Wright and Zxavian Harris, sources told ESPN's Pete Thamel.

stories.title: NCAA issues new guidance on 'standard timing protocol' in wake of U-M win
stories.summary: The NCAA is establishing a new standard timing protocol in the wake of the controversial decision to award Michigan an extra second despite the broadcast clock showing zeros.

stories.title: Michelsen, Tiafoe share moment at net: 'Don't think anyone else could have made me cry'
stories.summary: After handing his fellow American a crushing defeat in the US Open quarterfinals Tuesday, Frances Tiafoe held Alex Michelsen in a long embrace while the 22-year-old sobbed on his shoulder.
